statement: SDL 3.2.0 Switch HIDAPI reads device info and copies its six MAC bytes, then derives a hyphenated device serial from them via HIDAPI_SetDeviceSerial. It sets GUID byte 15 to the parsed controller type, not to the MAC; player index is assigned separately via SetDevicePlayerIndex and LED mapping.

applicability.revision: dekuNukem b354f21 / Linux 4056b3c / SDL 535d80b / OpenPuck 29f4d1e (as cited); retail firmware not measured
applicability.scope: SDL_hidapi_switch.c 629-652, 1357-1454, 1498-1509. A stable *per-instance virtual MAC* can affect SDL serial/USB/BT duplicate selection, but no evidence that MAC changes Steam's gyro mapping directly.
